page_description: An interactive demo for validating hai-framework LLM, image generation, TTS, ASR, and Memory capabilities.
hero_description: Call real AI APIs and inspect chat, image generation, long-term memory, speech synthesis, and transcription results.
profile_hint: Memories are isolated by ID and temporary memories reset when the server restarts.
chat_description: Multi-turn chat messages with optional memory injection and extraction.
chat_welcome: Hi, I am AI. Ask a question or tell me a preference you want me to remember.
chat_placeholder: Type a message, for example: Remember that I prefer concise answers.
memory_description: Add, search, or remove memories for the current test profile.
memory_add_placeholder: Add a fact, preference, or long-term instruction…
memory_search_placeholder: Enter a semantic query, or leave empty to list all
memory_empty: This profile has no memories yet
image_description: Generate an image through the configured OpenAI, Gemini, Qwen, Seedream, or free provider.
image_references_hint: Choose one or more images; model-specific count and format limits still apply.
image_default_prompt: A friendly robot building an open-source framework, clean isometric illustration
image_error_invalid_request: The image prompt or dimensions are invalid
image_error_invalid_reference: Each reference must be a non-empty image file no larger than 10 MiB
tts_description: Generate a playable WAV file from text.
tts_default_text: Hello, welcome to the hai-framework AI Playground.
asr_description: Upload WAV or MP3 audio and transcribe it to text.
asr_empty_result: The model did not recognize any text.
asr_error_file_size: Audio size must be between 1 byte and 10 MiB
asr_error_file_type: Only WAV and MP3 audio are supported
asr_error_language: Language must be auto, Chinese, or English
mic_description: See a live transcript while recording, without stopping first.
mic_placeholder: The transcript will update here while you record…
mic_error_unsupported: This browser does not support microphone recording.
mic_error_permission: Cannot access the microphone. Please check browser permissions.
mic_error_empty: No audio captured, please try again.
